heard: A corner shop in Saigon. The owner's hands are never free, so reorders happen from memory and often too late.
Before the hackathon, our project only synced supplier invoices. Now ShopVoice watches the shop a morning plan that remembers the owner's rules, and nothing bought without a spoken yes.
A simulated Alexa Plus experience live on our hosted demo. The MCP calls appear on the right.

Under the hood, a standard MCP server, 12 voice-first tools on Postgres with row-level security, hosted on render. The host keeps every confirmation token. The MCP inspector connects with a read-only judge token.
Vietnam has over a million corner shops. ShopVoice gives each one an agent that keeps watch, and our open source KiotViet MCP lets any KiotViet shop plug in. Try it now. The link is below.
